'''Sue White''' is a female student NPC from New Federation seen talking to her classmate, '''Yixin'''. They can be found at the Roya Market.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yixin:''' We just got a [[Chisa|new classmate]] from [[Ashinohara]]. It was wild hearing there are still places where Resonators aren't welcome...
:'''Sue White:''' Not surprised. Where I'm from, it's the same.
:'''Yixin:''' Even in the New Federation...?
:'''Sue White:''' Yeah. When my parents heard I could study at Startorch Academy, they were so happy they almost cried.
:'''Sue White:''' When my mom saw me off, she told me, "For the rest of your life, never come back. Stay far, far away from this place."
:'''Yixin:''' That's... brutal...
:'''Sue White:''' It's okay. My luck took a turn. Now I get to hang out with you guys every day.
{{Dialogue End}}
